context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: キュウリ/とうもろこし/にっこり/ガソリンスタンド/ホームセンター/クラスメート/うっすら/気さく

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、キュウリ、絶対、今日、絶対、収穫したよ
lines.en: Sho, I picked the cucumbers from the garden today — I'm telling you, it really happened.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact delivery with a hint of playful insistence on the 'absolute.' Warm mom-energy. Quick tempo, like she's sharing news she thinks he'll like.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、とうもろこし、絶対、ぼく、絶対、今日、絶対、食べたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to eat corn today — seriously, I do.
lines.style: Small, earnest voice. The request itself carries weight for him even if it's simple. Slight rise at the end, hopeful but not demanding. Genuine want underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、にっこり、絶対、笑ってたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandma was smiling so sweetly about it, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Speaks as if she can still see grandma's face. Warm without being theatrical. Slight lift on the image of the smile — she's sharing something tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、ガソリンスタンド、絶対、寄って、絶対、来るって、絶対、言ってたよ、ママ
lines.en: Your dad said he's going to stop at the gas station on the way back, Mom.
lines.style: Conversational, matter-of-fact report. Small voice relaying information like it's significant. No particular emotion — just passing it along to mom like she'd want to know.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 帰り道、本気で、絶対、ホームセンター、絶対、ママ、絶対、寄りたいわ、翔くん
lines.en: On the way home, I'd like to stop at the home center, Sho.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself but addressing him. Slower pace. The words sound like she's making a small plan in real-time. Gentle request, not a demand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: クラスメート、本気で、絶対、お家、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、近所に、絶対、引っ越してきたよ、ママ
lines.en: A classmate of mine just moved into the neighborhood — right near us, Mom.
lines.style: Bright, surprised delivery. The news comes out quick because he's still processing it. Pleased tone — this feels like something worth telling. Eager to share the update.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 外、本気で、絶対、雪が、絶対、うっすら、絶対、積もってきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: It's starting to snow outside — just a light dusting, Sho.
lines.style: Alert but calm observation. She's noticing something, drawing his attention to it. Steady tempo, like she's pointing something out the window. A touch of 'notice this' in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、気さくな、絶対、人だよね、ママ
lines.en: Your grandpa is such an easygoing person, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet admiration in his voice. Small, sincere statement about someone he likes. Comfortable warmth — he's thinking of grandpa fondly. No performance, just truth.
